title: Git Hook Trace Fixture
description: One recorded Git hook invocation, captured during Phase 0 for replay in Golden Tests (spec 9.7). Every field is exactly what the Hook Helper can observe at hook time; nothing is inferred.

hook.description: Which hook fired. Derived from the executable name because Git passes no hook name to these hooks.

seq.description: Order of this invocation within the scenario.

argv.description: Hook argv as a single string. post-merge: '0' normal, '1' squash. post-rewrite: 'amend' or 'rebase'.

stdin.description: Raw stdin, newlines replaced by '|'. post-rewrite carries '<old-sha> <new-sha>' pairs here; other hooks receive nothing.

branch.description: Short branch name; empty when detached.

reflog_gs.description: HEAD reflog %gs of the newest entry, as written by THIS git version. Never treat as a cross-version contract (spec 9.6).

reflog_has_head.description: Whether HEAD already appeared in the reflog when the hook ran. Measured true for every post-commit in Git 2.54.0.

git_dir.description: `git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir`. Differs from <repo>/.git inside a worktree.

self_micros.description: Wall time the probe process spent collecting facts, microseconds. Diagnostic only.
